Type Theory as a Programming Language

Type-theoretic languages combine programming with formal reasoning.

  • Programming: executable models and applicable design steps.
  • Formal reasoning: specify and verify properties of models and design steps.

Candidate foundation: Quantitative Type Theory in Idris2.
